customManagers.description: Track container image versions in Pulumi stack configs

packageRules.description: No auto-merge for image updates until a black-box test is a required check and the release-age window applies (owner decision, homelab#100)

Our own app images (mrsimpson, digitaleraluhut): installed soon and automatically, one PR per image, at any time (the CronJob runs every 30 minutes, homelab#176). No release-age window: we publish these ourselves. Merging deploys it; a bad release is undone by reverting the tag.

agentic-office hub: new releases are frequent and should be installed soon, automatically. Merging deploys it; a bad release is undone by reverting the tag. After the rollout the smoke job of deploy-apps.yml checks the hub (there is no black-box test before the merge yet: homelab#100). Own group and any time: the shared preset groups patches into one PR scheduled for Saturday mornings (github>mrsimpson/renovate-config), which held 0.4.1 back.

Upstream opencode, the base of apps/opencode/docker (dockerfile manager): new releases at any time, a day after publication; non-major updates are merged automatically by the shared preset. The merge builds opencode-dev, which the own-image rule then rolls out.
